{{Top|leg}}
'''Choya bread''' was a type of [[Bread/Legends|bread]] made on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It was often served with [[Dalkash ale]], and was also used to make pastry shells and crumbled to bake [[fish stick]]s in.
